name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 4 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-07-14, at wavelengths from 1.30 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
